name: Hybrid kd-tree/Uniform Grid
aliases: Hybrid kd-tree/uniform grid structure (Zellmann et al.)
definition: A hybrid data structure combining a kd-tree structure at the root level and a uniform grid at the leaf-node level used for empty-space skipping.
summary: This acceleration structure combines a kd-tree root with uniform grid leaves to decouple tree depth from skipping granularity, enabling faster construction and fine-grained empty-space skipping in large volume datasets.
